population: Frozen Haze4K 768-image development ledger; provisional A0 outer test folds 0 and 1 only.

primary_estimands.contrast: spatial candidate-response policy minus exact no-op
primary_estimands.aggregation: fixed 20% group coverage; worse operator inside each paired bootstrap draw

primary_estimands.contrast: selected gain divided by paired three-action oracle gain
spatial policy gain minus pooled/DC-only policy gain
primary_estimands.aggregation: matched names, actions, coverage, operators, folds, seeds, and bootstrap draws
primary_estimands.claim_limit: increment of this fixed representation-readout contract

primary_estimands.contrast: true spatial policy gain minus within-image spatial-shuffle policy gain
primary_estimands.claim_limit: layout-specific increment, not causal localization to semantics

safety_estimands.gate: zero events and one-sided exact all-group UCB95 <= 0.010

safety_estimands.definition: CVaR5 of spatial gain minus pooled gain at matched 20% coverage
clustered mean local harm in held-out cells where no-op is local oracle and no-op MSE is below the outer-training-fold 25th percentile

secondary_estimands: fold, seed, operator, and native-shape stability
local cancellation prevalence and protected/heavy-recovery cell tails

uncertainty.pairing: retain all cells, actions, seeds, and both operators for each sampled group
uncertainty.operator_rule: take worse operator within each draw
uncertainty.intervals: percentile 95 percent unless exact one-sided binomial UCB is specified

multiplicity: One preregistered primary gate family; every listed primary, specificity, coverage, integrity, and safety gate must pass. Secondary estimands cannot rescue a failure.

threshold_sources.retention_0.25: pre-existing requirement to retain a material quarter of oracle headroom
threshold_sources.coverage_0.20: pre-cloud E3 planning contract; fixed here to remove coverage tuning
